Locate or Open the HapBlockR Breeder's Guide

Source: R/breeder_guide.R
open_breeder_guide.Rd

The PDF and Word editions of the HapBlockR Breeder's Guide are standalone companions to the From Local GEBV to a Crossing Decision vignette – the same nine parent- and cross-selection tools (truncation_selection, select_parents_ga, select_parents_ga_ts, select_parents_by_family, usefulness_criterion, select_parents_ocs, select_parents_pareto, validate_crosses_exact, select_core_collection), explained in plain language – what each is, when to use it, its variants, how it works, and how to interpret its output – with breeding-programme analogies and a programme-shape decision guide, and no R code required to read it. It is intended for breeders, programme managers, or reviewers who will use or approve a crossing decision but do not necessarily run R themselves.

Usage

open_breeder_guide(open = TRUE, format = c("pdf", "html"))

Arguments

open

Logical, default TRUE. If TRUE and the session is interactive, opens the file with the operating system's default application for the selected file via browseURL. If FALSE, or the session is non-interactive, the file is not opened – only its path is returned.

format

Character, one of "pdf" (default) or "html". Selects the tagged fixed-layout edition or the editable Word edition.

Value

The file path (character, invisibly) to the selected guide edition in the installed package. The function reports an explicit error if the requested edition is unavailable.

Details

The tagged PDF provides a fixed reference edition and the Word document provides an editable edition for programme-specific annotation. These standalone files have no vignette engine, so they are not indexed by vignette()/browseVignettes() like the package's .Rmd vignettes. Their version-controlled source is inst/guide/HapBlockR_Breeder_Guide.md; both generated files ship in inst/extdata/ and are located via system.file.

See also

The From Local GEBV to a Crossing Decision vignette (vignette("HapBlockR-breeding-decisions", package = "HapBlockR")) for the same nine tools with full statistical detail and runnable R code; select_parents_ga, select_parents_ga_ts, usefulness_criterion, select_parents_ocs.

Examples

pdf_path <- open_breeder_guide(open = FALSE)
#> [open_breeder_guide] Guide located at: C:/Users/fakohoue/AppData/Local/R/win-library/4.5/HapBlockR/extdata/HapBlockR_Breeder_Guide.pdf
word_path <- open_breeder_guide(open = FALSE, format = "html")
#> [open_breeder_guide] Guide located at: C:/Users/fakohoue/AppData/Local/R/win-library/4.5/HapBlockR/extdata/HapBlockR_Breeder_Guide.html
file.exists(pdf_path)
#> [1] TRUE
file.exists(word_path)
#> [1] TRUE
